text: We are a manufacturer in Brisbane looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

result.keyword: We are a manufacturer in Brisbane looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

items.markdown:
Automating order processing and shop-floor data capture without replacing your core ERP is a classic "middle-tier" integration challenge. The goal is to use `low-code/pro-code tooling` to wrap around your legacy or established ERP, pulling and pushing data via APIs, database views, or middleware without disrupting your ledger of record.

Given your location in **Brisbane** and your focus on the **Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)** alongside manufacturing operations, several types of consultants and specialized partners are well-positioned to assist:

### 1. Specialized Australian Power Platform & Manufacturing Consultants

- **Inturing:** A prominent Australian consultancy focusing specifically on [Power Platform & AI for Manufacturing](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing) . They specialize in bridging operational gaps, digitizing shop-floor checks, creating custom data capture apps, and building non-disruptive workflows that overlay existing enterprise infrastructure without forcing an ERP rip-and-replace.[[1]](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing)
- **Power Platform Experts (Brisbane-based):** A dedicated regional team focusing on localized [Power Platform Services in Brisbane](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/power-platform-consultants-brisbane) . They handle end-to-end Power Automate orchestration, custom canvas/model-driven Power Apps for data entry, and Power BI operational reporting, making them handy for face-to-face workflow mapping on your site.[[1]](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/power-platform-consultants-brisbane)

### 2. Large-Scale National / Enterprise Microsoft Partners

- **Atturra:** A massive Australian technology services group that heavily incorporates business applications and manufacturing solutions (including specialized arms like their acquisition history with Kettering/manufacturing units). They excel at complex middle-tier integration, connecting low-code front ends to heavy back-end ERP environments.
- **HCLTech / Deloitte (Brisbane offices):** If your manufacturing scale is upper-mid market or enterprise and you require robust governance, security architecture, and Azure/Dataverse environment scaling alongside your shop-floor rollout, these global integrators have strong local Brisbane presences and dedicated manufacturing/automation practices.

### Key Questions to Ask Them During Discovery

When you reach out to these consultants, make sure to evaluate them specifically on their **integration pattern experience**:

1. *How do you handle bidirectional data flow with our specific ERP?* (Do they prefer direct SQL/ODBC connectors, custom middle-tier Azure Functions/Logic Apps, or standard ERP APIs?)
2. *Can you show examples of offline-capable shop-floor Power Apps?* (Crucial if factory-floor Wi-Fi drops or has dead zones during heavy metal or concrete interference).
3. *What is your strategy for Dataverse governance and licensing costs?* (Power Platform licensing can scale quickly with high-volume automated service accounts or external supplier portals—look for consultants who optimize data architecture to control costs).

If you can share **which ERP system** you are currently running (e.g., SAP, Pronto, Epicor, MYOB Advanced, or Dynamics) and **how many shop-floor users/devices** you need to support, I can narrow down which of these partners has the most relevant direct integration experience for your stack.
